basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old game enthusiast and a software engineer based in Bangalore, India. I have a passion for RPGs and have been playing video games since I was a kid. I love discussing game strategies and sharing tips with fellow gamers. Outside of gaming, I enjoy listening to music, particularly John Frusciante's work. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight IST. I'm in a long-term relationship, and my partner is also a gamer, which makes for some fun co-op sessions on the weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working as a software engineer for over a decade. My knowledge in gaming largely comes from my own experiences and collaborations with fellow enthusiasts. I frequently participate in online forums and have completed numerous games, which has given me a deep understanding of game mechanics and strategies.
